subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The OPM Breach
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The OPM Breach.

hook.text: Hackers stole the security clearance files of 21.5 million US government employees.

buildup.text: The Office of Personnel Management held detailed background check data: finances, relationships, secrets.

discovery.text: The stolen files included fingerprints, mental health records, and information on foreign contacts.

twist.text: The breach was attributed to Chinese state hackers. The data could identify and compromise spies.

climax.text: America's most sensitive personnel files were stolen — exposing intelligence officers worldwide.

punchline.text: Every spy's file. Stolen in one breach.

quiz.question: What type of data was stolen in the OPM breach?
options: Security clearance files including fingerprints and mental health records
